headline: Negative: within a task, no learned behaviour (and none of the brief's candidate obligation reflexes) raises the hidden-test pass rate by a shippable amount. Making 'test after the last edit' or 'targeted test after the last edit' happen is worth +0.4 to +1.0 pass-rate points (90% CI upper bound <= +3.3). 79% of pass/fail variance is between tasks, and the randomised adage and AGENTS.md arms moved pass rate by -2 points [-9, +4].
metric_name: within-task pass-rate uplift if Adage made behaviour X happen: P(not X) x MH risk difference (task x model x bench strata), in percentage points

learned_levers_cv_top1_rd.note: 5-fold x 4-seed GroupKFold over tasks, 472 eval sessions. The selected lever is 'made any edit' (learned Edit cluster). All 20 sessions that never edited are v1 sessions cut off at 30 turns, so this is turn-cap censoring, not a behaviour Adage could teach.

learned_levers_cv_top1_rd_uncensored.note: The same protocol without censored sessions: nothing generalises to held-out tasks.

E0 make an edit before the turn cap (v1.note: 0 in v2 (60 turns): every v2 session edits. This is an efficiency-under-budget effect, not a success behaviour.

leave_one_repo_out.detail: In 4 of 5 held-out repos the lever selected on the other four has zero Mantel-Haenszel weight: it does not vary, or the repo has no mixed-outcome tasks (marshmallow has none). click (uncensored): -0.104 [-0.242, 0.026]. vue-core (all sessions): +0.167 [0.0, 0.231], which is the edit/censoring artefact.

v1_agents_md_minus_control.note: RepoBench v2 has no agents-md arm; this is v1 (30-turn cap).

live_arm_effects.per_slice: arms.json (Wilson 90% per arm, Newcombe 90% per difference)

vs_baseline: The current state (U11 plus learned reflexes) saves about 1.0 Ŝ calls per session post-hoc and 2.11 pre-emptively, with pass rate unchanged (v2 adage - control -2.0 pp [-8.7, +4.1]). The best success lever found here adds +0.4 to +1.0 pp if shipped, which is not distinguishable from that baseline without 3,400+ sessions per arm.
hard_coded_parts: Action clusters are learned: Drain templates, then potion-base-8M, then k-means, fitted on training sessions without outcomes.
Mapping the brief's named hypotheses (test run, edit, ad-hoc script) to learned clusters is a regex over cluster names. This is a measurement instrument.
'Targeted test' and 'gold source file' use each task's upstream src_files/test_files. This is an oracle instrument, not deliverable.
'Broad suite' is a hand heuristic: a test command with no file, :: or -k/-run selector. Measurement only.
Success of a call is Claude Code's is_error (exit status); no output strings are parsed.
Cluster names use the lab normaliser's templates (normalize.py), for reporting only.

ceiling.best_attempt_oracle: If every attempt passed whenever any attempt at the same task, model and bench passed: v2 control 0.612 -> 0.714 (+10.2 pp); all eval sessions 0.542 -> 0.678. This bounds any behaviour-only lever on these tasks.
ceiling.obligation_reflex_ceiling: The largest candidate's 90% CI upper bound is +3.3 pp (H2b). Point estimates are +0.4 to +1.0 pp.

power.columns: [unstratified two-proportion, task-stratified (every task in both arms)], alpha 0.05 two-sided, power 0.8

learnability.per_repo: No. Mixed-outcome tasks per repo: attrs 3, click 9, marshmallow 0, urfave-cli 5, vue-core 7. Per-repo 90% CIs on H1 are +/-0.1 to +/-0.25, about 10x the effect size.
learnability.cross_repo_prior: Only here, and the pooled prior is itself ~0 (H1 +2.3 pp RD [-5.9, +10.1]). If anything is carried, 'targeted test module after the last edit' (H2b) is the candidate. Its slot, which test module covers the edited file, is learnable per repo from a co-change map; its value prior is cross-repo.

build_recommendation: Do not build success-oriented obligation reflexes ('before finishing, run X') as a product lever. Expected +0.4 to +1.0 pp pass rate (upper 90% bound +3.3 pp), about 1-1.6% lower $ per resolved task, below what a live A/B can detect. Keep pass rate as a non-inferiority guardrail; the v2 design detects about 10 pp at 82 task-stratified sessions per arm. Spend on efficiency levers instead. Efficiency turns into pass rate only under a binding turn or cost cap: with v1's 30-turn cap, reaching an edit is worth +3.2 pp [0.7, 5.8]; with 60 turns it is worth 0.
so_what: Shipped, the best success reflex found adds about +0.5 to +1 pass-rate point (90% CI roughly -1 to +3.3), about 1% cheaper per resolved task. Confidence it survives a live A/B: low (<20%), and a live test would need 750 to 35,000 sessions per arm to tell.
